snippet.title: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at action-packed gameplay from Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown in this trailer for the upcoming sci-fi Combat Racing game inspired by retro arcade racers. Race across vibrant alien worlds, defeat opponents in destruction-rich environments, and become the Cosmic Champion. Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown will be available on PC. A demo for Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown will be available on Steam beginning July 28, 2025.

#IGN #Gaming
